import json
import re

def check_similarity(name1, name2):
    # Check if inputs are JSON tuples
    try:
        name1 = json.loads(name1)
        name2 = json.loads(name2)
    except json.JSONDecodeError:
        pass

    # If inputs are tuples, extract the first element
    if isinstance(name1, tuple):
        name1 = name1[0]
    if isinstance(name2, tuple):
        name2 = name2[0]

    # Remove special characters and convert to lower case
    name1 = re.sub(r'[^a-zA-Z0-9\s]', '', name1).lower()
    name2 = re.sub(r'[^a-zA-Z0-9\s]', '', name2).lower()

    # Check if the two names are similar
    if name1 in name2 or name2 in name1:
        return 1
    else:
        return 0

# Test the function
name1 = input("Name of Official: ")
name2 = input("Senior Officials Name: ")
print(check_similarity(name1, name2))

def check_similarity(name, purpose):
    name_set = set(name.lower().split())
    purpose_set = set(purpose.lower().split())
    common_words = name_set.intersection(purpose_set)
    if len(common_words) > 0:
        return 1
    else:
        return 0
